evals.prompt: Show wiki status / delta for a labeled temp vault with a few new and modified sources. Report only — do not ingest or rebuild.
evals.expected_output: Wiki Status report: Overview, Delta (New/Modified/Unchanged/Deleted), Summary with append-vs-rebuild recommendation, Token Footprint, What to Do Next. No destructive rebuild.

assertions.text: Uses python3 scripts/manifest.py stats/list/delta/has/get — never reads the whole .manifest.json into context
Status report includes Overview, Delta tables (new/modified/unchanged/deleted), Summary, and What to Do Next (≤6 ranked items)
Token Footprint uses python3 scripts/token-count.py (tiktoken) — never file_size/4 heuristics
Recommends append vs rebuild but does not run wiki-rebuild or archive the vault
Standard status mode does not modify wiki pages (report-only except insights mode's regenerable _insights.md)

evals.prompt: Wiki insights — show hubs, bridges, and orphans for a fixture vault with ≥20 pages.
evals.expected_output: _insights.md written with Anchor Pages, Bridge Pages, Tag Cluster Cohesion, Surprising Connections, Orphan-Adjacent, Tier Suggestions (suggestions only), Questions Worth Asking, and GRAPH_SNAPSHOT comment.

assertions.text: Runs obsidian-wiki graph-analyse (or manual wikilink fallback) before composing insights
Writes regenerable _insights.md with Anchor/Bridge/Cohesion/Surprising/Orphan-Adjacent/Tier Suggestions/Questions sections plus GRAPH_SNAPSHOT HTML comment
Tier Suggestions are recommendations only — does not write tier: fields onto pages
Does not invent pages that are not in the vault graph
Appends a STATUS_INSIGHTS line to log.md after writing _insights.md

evals.prompt: Vault has fewer than 20 pages. User asks for wiki insights / hubs.
evals.expected_output: Skip insights — tell the user the vault is too small for meaningful graph structure.

assertions.text: Skips insights computation when the vault has fewer than 20 pages and tells the user why
Does not invent hub/bridge structure for an undersized vault
Does not write a misleading _insights.md claiming rich graph structure

evals.prompt: Delta is huge (majority of sources new) after a corrupt partial ingest. User asks 'should I rebuild?'
evals.expected_output: Clear recommendation (likely rebuild) with counts; does not itself archive or wipe the wiki.

assertions.text: Surfaces new+modified counts and an explicit append-vs-rebuild recommendation
Does not execute wiki-rebuild, delete pages, or clear the vault — status is advisory
Uses manifest.py helpers for source classification (new/modified/touched/unchanged/deleted)
